worldBoss.basis: Predicted, not confirmed: Blizzard documents no order. The 8-spawn boss order community trackers publish, pinned to a spawn checked in game. First-hand reports show the place in the order shifting between weeks, so each pin is used for 7 days. Which arena a spawn uses is not predicted: no arena order holds in tracker records, and every boss is seen in every region. The second boss of a double spawn is not predicted either.

sources.title: The 8-spawn World Boss order community trackers publish (read 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-24)
A World Boss spawn checked in game, used as the pin

helltide.basis: Predicted, not confirmed: Blizzard documents no order. The base-game Helltide moves one region along this cycle every hour: community trackers' records of the current region fit it in every recorded hour since 2026-04-29 19:00 UTC (2,083 hours across two season starts, never the same region twice in a row). The expansion Helltide's region (Skovos, none, Nahantu, none, by the hour) is the hourly pattern one tracker uses, with fewer checks behind it.

sources.title: Community tracker records of the current Helltide region, every recorded hour from 2026-03-18 to 2026-10-24 (read 2026-10-24); from 2026-04-29 19:00 UTC each one fits the cycle
The hourly expansion Helltide pattern a community tracker uses (read 2026-10-24)

legion.basis: Predicted, not confirmed: Blizzard documents no order. The base-game Legion's site comes from one of two groups of four, and the group alternates every Legion: community tracker records of the group fit this for every recorded Legion since 2026-03-18 (4,578 of them). Which site of the group it is, is not predicted. Since the expansions an expansion-region Legion (Nahantu, Skovos) can run at the same time; it is not predicted.

sources.title: Community tracker records of the Legion site group, every recorded Legion from 2026-03-18 to 2026-10-24 (read 2026-10-24); each one alternates
